mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ipe_simulator.device_state (state_key, device_id, protocol, pile_code, snapshot) VALUES (#{stateKey}, #{deviceId}, #{protocol}, #{pileCode}, #{snapshot}) ON CONFLICT (state_key) DO UPDATE SET snapshot = EXCLUDED.snapshot, updated_at = current_timestamp

INSERT INTO ipe_simulator.charging_record (state_key, transaction_no, device_id, protocol, pile_code, gun_no, start_time, end_time, meter_start, meter_end, total_energy, loss_total_energy, total_amount, stop_reason, bill) VALUES
(#{row.stateKey}, #{row.transactionNo}, #{row.deviceId}, #{row.protocol}, #{row.pileCode}, #{row.gunNo}, #{row.startTime}, #{row.endTime}, #{row.meterStart}, #{row.meterEnd}, #{row.totalEnergy}, #{row.lossTotalEnergy}, #{row.totalAmount}, #{row.stopReason}, cast(#{row.billJson} as jsonb))
ON CONFLICT (state_key, transaction_no) DO NOTHING
